description: Find agent skills (SKILL.md packs for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok Build and Grok Bot) by name, publisher or topic. Call get_skill for the install command.

limit.description: Results per page. Default 8. Without a key at most 10.

query.description: Topic or name, for example pdf, frontend design, or testing. Empty lists the most starred skills.

response_format.description: json (default) or markdown for a human-readable text block. structuredContent is always JSON.

name: search_skills

total_capped.description: True when there are more than 1000 matches.

title: Search agent skills
